notes: IFRS throughout. Each year's figures are taken from the following year's annual report (prior-year column) so that restatements are reflected; FY2025 from Annual Report 2025

revenue = sales revenue; operatingIncome = operating result (FY2007-FY2010 'operating profit'); revenue, operating result, total assets and operating cash flow follow the latest Five-Year Review (AR2025 for 2021-2025, AR2020 for 2016-2020, AR2015 for 2011-2015, AR2010 for 2007-2010)

netIncome = earnings attributable to Volkswagen AG shareholders (excludes hybrid capital investors and noncontrolling interests); totalEquity = equity attributable to Volkswagen AG shareholders (excludes hybrid capital and noncontrolling interests)
dilutedEPS and dividendPerShare are per PREFERRED share (VOW3 is the preferred line); basic and diluted are equal from FY2010; FY2025 dividend is the proposal to the 2026 AGM
operatingCashFlow = Group cash flows from operating activities; FY2007 and FY2008 were adjusted in AR2010 (originally 15,662M and 10,799M) after a change in presentation

capex = Group investments in property, plant and equipment, investment property and intangible assets excluding capitalized development costs (FY2007-FY2012: acquisition of property, plant and equipment); capitalized development costs (e.g. 9,047M in 2025) are excluded
employees = total workforce at Dec. 31 including the Chinese joint ventures (Key Figures); FY2017-FY2023 published in thousands to one decimal
FY2015 loss reflects diesel-issue special items of 16.9bn; FY2017 operating cash flow is negative because of diesel payments

Yahoo net income is 4-9% higher in 2022-2025 because it includes the share attributable to hybrid capital investors; this file follows the brief (owners of the parent excluding hybrid capital), e.g. 2025 earnings after tax 6,904M, of which Volkswagen AG shareholders 6,673M
